note: Per-domain print-to-part pipeline definition. Engine mappings are best-effort initial mappings; operators refine via the same JSON. 'status' values: built (engine wired + producing) | partial (built but unwired or partially covered) | missing (no engine yet, gap). The 'adaptive' field flags stages where the orchestrator must handle missing user input intelligently with safe defaults.

canonical_stages.label: Print intake
canonical_stages.desc: Upload + validate blueprint PDF / CAD STEP / IGES / DXF / IPT / SLDPRT / .min sample

canonical_stages.label: Geometry parse
canonical_stages.desc: BREP from CAD; build solid model from .stp/.iges/.x_t/.x_b

canonical_stages.label: Print OCR
canonical_stages.desc: PDF blueprint → dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, title-block (eDOCr2 / PaddleOCR / vision LLM)

canonical_stages.label: Feature recognition
canonical_stages.desc: Pockets, holes, threads, slots, faces, ID/OD, grooves; ML + rule-based

canonical_stages.label: Material select
canonical_stages.desc: From print spec or operator → material DB → Kienzle/Taylor params, machinability, hardness, ISO group

canonical_stages.label: Machine select
canonical_stages.desc: Match part envelope + kinematics + controller to available machines (JM-DIE 21-machine fleet)

canonical_stages.label: Tooling select
canonical_stages.desc: Tool DB lookup (287 .tooldb, 131MB); geometry-compatible; prefer existing inventory; cost-aware

canonical_stages.label: Fixture / workholding
canonical_stages.desc: Workholding by geometry, accessibility, machine; vise/chuck/3R/custom; force adequacy gate

canonical_stages.label: Operation sequence
canonical_stages.desc: Order of ops, setup count, datum strategy, roughing→semi→finish, S(x)-gated

canonical_stages.label: Speed / feed calc
canonical_stages.desc: Kienzle force, Taylor tool-life, deflection, machine HP/torque limits, GilbertEconomicSpeed cost triad

canonical_stages.label: Toolpath generation
canonical_stages.desc: Domain-specific: mill=3-axis/5-axis, lathe=turning/grooving/threading, wire=wire-cut path, sinker=electrode path

canonical_stages.label: Safety validate
canonical_stages.desc: Collision, force, thermal, workholding adequacy, vibration; Ω≥0.95 / S(x)≥0.98 for shop-floor

canonical_stages.label: Post-process to NC
canonical_stages.desc: Controller-specific NC: Fanuc/Haas/Okuma/Mitsubishi/Mazak/Heidenhain/Hurco; master-post or CAM bridge

canonical_stages.label: Pre-cut simulate
canonical_stages.desc: Virtual machining, voxel/swept-volume stock removal, collision sim, cycle-time

canonical_stages.label: Operator approval
canonical_stages.desc: UNCONDITIONAL human-in-loop gate before machine touches material (CLAUDE.md doctrine)

canonical_stages.label: Machine execution
canonical_stages.desc: DNC drip / NCnet load; MTConnect / OPC-UA telemetry capture; tool-wear monitoring

canonical_stages.label: Quality verify
canonical_stages.desc: CMM measurement, FAI, SPC, Cpk; first-article gate; ongoing-production sampling

canonical_stages.label: Closed-loop learning
canonical_stages.desc: Outcomes → tribal corpus → SF refinement → material-band update → strategy weights

adaptive_orchestrator.purpose: The connective tissue that runs the canonical pipeline for any incoming part with: (a) intelligent defaults when user input is missing, (b) cost-optimal path selection (cheapest machine/tool/strategy that meets the constraint), (c) machine/tooling/fixture adaptation based on shop inventory, (d) safety-gated proceed/halt at every stage (Ω≥0.95, S(x)≥0.98). Single highest-leverage missing engine — without it the per-domain stage engines don't compose into a real print-to-part pipeline.

missing_data_policy.material: default to most-common JM-DIE stock for the part envelope + flag operator with confidence score
missing_data_policy.machine: pick cheapest machine with envelope fit AND required kinematics AND adequate spindle HP
missing_data_policy.tooling: prefer existing tool-crib geometry-compatible tool; propose closest match if exact unavailable; flag if substitution > 10% deviation
missing_data_policy.fixture: default vise-with-stop for mill, 3-jaw chuck for lathe, 3R clamp for wire — with workholding-force adequacy gate
missing_data_policy.tolerance: default to ISO 2768 medium grade when print-OCR fails to extract; flag operator
missing_data_policy.feature_recog_low_confidence: fall back to operator-confirm dialog with feature-tree visualization
missing_data_policy.speed_feed: Kienzle defaults from ISO material group when published k-c missing

adaptive_orchestrator.cost_pick_policy: GilbertEconomicSpeedEngine triad (min-cost / max-prod / max-profit) ranks alternatives; default to max-profit unless operator overrides; never pick a configuration that fails safety gate even if it's the cheapest
adaptive_orchestrator.safety_invariant: NO stage transitions to MACHINE_RUN without OPERATOR_GATE explicit approval; SAFETY_VALIDATE failures hard-block — never auto-override

summary.highest_leverage_gap: PrintToProgramOrchestratorEngine — the adaptive orchestrator that wires per-stage engines into a real print-to-part flow
